_comment: Surface classes used by the temperature / specific-humidity case.
Everything here is an ASSUMPTION that you should replace with your own values.
'auto' for a deep temperature means the annual mean of the EPW dry-bulb.
Humidity sources are ANALYTIC (tools/humidity_sources.py): ponds and lawns as permanently wet surfaces (surface energy balance with evaporation), Penman-Monteith tree transpiration in daylight.

default.label: bare ground / soil (anything not inside a pond, lawn or pathway polygon)

pond.label: pond water surface (json 'ponds'), always wet, surface energy balance
_note: method: energy_balance (default) | wet_bulb (surface at the EPW thermodynamic wet-bulb temperature, no solar heating) | fixed (uses temperature_C).
thermal.conductivity is an EFFECTIVE value (water is mixed): h_g = conductivity/depth_m couples the surface to the deep water at deep_temperature_C.
albedo / emissivity set the absorbed sunlight and long-wave exchange; shading by buildings and trees is included automatically.

trees._note: Big-leaf Penman-Monteith; flux is per m2 of crown surface (= LE/lambda * crown_area_ratio).
